vision.name: Blue Preventive Mastery
vision.text:
[Defense] POWER: Use only on the first attack your opponent performs in combat. Prevent all damage from this attack. You may discard a card from your hand to make this attack deal no damage.
POWER: Lower a player's anger 1. The next time one of your opponent's effects would raise their anger this combat, change that amount to 0.
